title: Mango lassi
ingredients: 2 ripe mangoes, peeled and chopped (or 2 cups frozen mango chunks)
steps: Combine the mango, yoghurt, milk, honey and cardamom in a blender.
Blend until completely smooth, about 30 seconds.
Taste and adjust the honey depending on how ripe the mango is.
Add the ice and blend again until frothy and well chilled.
Pour into glasses and top with pistachios if using.
notes: Frozen mango skips the ice and blends up thicker, which is nice for a rushed breakfast.
